title: Periapical Radiography AI Training Assistant

pathologyWorkflowStep1Desc: Select imaging technique (Paralleling / Bisecting), receptor type, and target tooth.
pathologyWorkflowStep2Desc: Upload clinical radiograph. Gemini automatically segments and detects 8 supported structures and abnormalities.

disclaimerDesc: PeriApicAI is an experimental research prototype and has not been clinically validated. AI-generated technical assessments and suspected findings are intended for research, education, and decision support only.
disclaimerAdvice: Results are not a substitute for professional dental diagnosis, treatment planning, or clinical judgment. All AI output must be independently interpreted and verified by a qualified dental professional before any clinical decision.
